unsupported_query.summary: The query is not supported. Review its SQL against sourcesql_capabilities before starting new work.

invalid_query.summary: The query could not be executed. Review its SQL and input bindings before starting new work.

invalid_request.summary: The request is invalid. Review its arguments before starting new work.

budget_exhausted.summary: A configured execution allowance was exhausted. Inspect this job or run before authorizing further work.

unsupported_capability.summary: A required capability is unavailable in this configuration. Check sourcesql_capabilities before starting new work.

unauthorized.summary: The operation is not authorized for this connection.

disclosure_required.summary: The operation requires explicit disclosure authorization.

evidence_invalid.summary: Source evidence failed validation. Inspect the saved run before continuing.

invalid_output.summary: Research output failed validation. Inspect the saved run before continuing.

provider_unavailable.summary: A required provider or dependency is unavailable. Inspect this job or run before continuing.

provider_timeout.summary: A provider request timed out. Its remote outcome may be unknown; inspect the saved run before retrying.

provider_connection_error.summary: A provider connection failed. Its remote outcome may be unknown; inspect the saved run before retrying.

provider_http_error.summary: A provider rejected a request. Inspect the saved run before continuing.

provider_error.summary: A provider request failed. Inspect the saved run before continuing.

storage_conflict.summary: Stored state changed concurrently. Inspect this job or run before continuing.

storage_unavailable.summary: Durable storage is unavailable. Inspect this job or run before continuing.

cancelled.summary: Execution was cancelled. No further work starts from status inspection.

flight_definition_changed.summary: The pinned worker configuration changed. Review the worker configuration before starting new work.

execution_outcome_unknown.summary: Execution outcome is unknown. Inspect this job or run; do not automatically resubmit it.

execution_failed.summary: Research execution failed safely. Inspect this job or run before continuing.

idempotency_conflict.summary: That request ID was already used with different parameters. Use a new request ID, or repeat the original request unchanged.

revision_conflict.summary: The research changed since you read it. Reread it and apply your change again.
